question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. A is taller than only two other friends. C is shorter than only one friend. E is shorter than A but taller than B. F is shorter than D. Who is the tallest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height.

1) A is taller than only two other friends.

__ > __ > __ > A > __ > __

2) C is shorter than only one friend.

__ > C > __ > A > __ > __

3) E is shorter than A but taller than B.

__ > C > __ > A > E > B

4) F is shorter than D.

D > C > F > A > E > B

So, '**D**' is the tallest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
